title: Popover
description: A small panel anchored to its trigger — for detail that does not deserve a page.
usage: For rich, short content tied to one element: share panels, quick info, mini forms. Not for plain text — that is the Tooltip.
a11y: The non-modal dialog panel has an automatically linked trigger with aria-expanded. Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger. A null focusout target is ignored. Outside presses and focus leaving the component close without stealing focus. On narrow screens the panel shifts to stay inside the viewport. Closed panels are inert and hidden; zero-duration transitions complete immediately with a timeout fallback otherwise. Existing IDs are preserved. Beta until a recorded screen-reader pass.
